name: Containe Technologies Ltd.
summary: Containe Technologies Ltd. engages in the business of automobile safety and GPS solutions in automobile sector. It also manufactures electronic Speed Limiting Device, “MOTOREYE & LIMITS” Brand Electronic Fuel Regulator & Pedal Interface, suitable for the latest Vehicle of BS-IV Standards to the Oldest Vehicles. The company was founded by Anand Kumar Seethala and Botcha Bhavani on September 16, 2008 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.
